instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Total score per subject
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Average score per subject
output: SELECT subject, AVG(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Maximum score per subject
output: SELECT subject, MAX(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
subject with total score above 1000
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject HAVING SUM(score) > 1000;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
subject groups having more than 5 records
output: SELECT subject, COUNT(*) FROM grades GROUP BY subject HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Count records per subject
output: SELECT subject, COUNT(*) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Total score grouped by subject ordered by total desc
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) AS tot FROM grades GROUP BY subject ORDER BY tot DESC;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Minimum score per subject
output: SELECT subject, MIN(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Average score where score > 0
output: SELECT AVG(score) FROM grades WHERE score > 0;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Total score for records after 2024
output: SELECT SUM(score) FROM grades;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Rollup of subject with totals
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) FROM grades GROUP BY ROLLUP(subject);

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Cube of subject with totals
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) FROM grades GROUP BY CUBE(subject);

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Standard deviation of score
output: SELECT STDDEV(score) FROM grades;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Variance of score
output: SELECT VARIANCE(score) FROM grades;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Total score for each subject having at least 2 rows
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Median of score per subject
output: SELECT subject, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY score) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Sum and count combined per subject
output: SELECT subject, SUM(score), COUNT(*) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Grouping by two columns subject and score
output: SELECT subject, score, COUNT(*) FROM grades GROUP BY subject, score;

instruction:
Schema: grades(student_id, subject, score)
Number of distinct student_id per subject
output: SELECT subject, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM grades GROUP BY subject;
